description: Kerala has initiated a groundbreaking endeavour by launching AI training sessions for 80,000 school teachers.
body_lead: Results for " Kerala has initiated a groundbreaking endeavour by launching AI training sessions for 80,000 school teachers. Organized by the Kerala Infrastructure and Technology for Education (KITE) under the General Education Department, Government of Kerala, this three-day training program aims to equip teachers from Classes 8 to 12 with essential AI skills by August 2024. "AI offers exciting possibilities for education, but it's crucial to understand its full potential and limitations in this field.
